purpose: Fail-closed admission gate for the first production process migration (SNOW). F-PM does not merge lineages or modify production process source before one shared downstream production basis is explicitly qualified for physical SWAP use.

shared_downstream_qualification.reason: Generic runtime qualification is insufficient. The composed candidate must explicitly admit physical SWAP use; F-MR01 currently qualifies only the deterministic test backend.

transaction_minimum.successor_policy: F-KT06/F-KT07 may be present as qualified successors because they retain the F-KT05 generic transaction kernel; moving/unqualified successors are not consumed.

observed_not_admitted.reason: Qualification record still states final_postimage_verification_required=true and full real parallel/process-provider reentrancy remains blocked. Do not consume as a final shared production basis.

solver_lineages.rule: Candidate must match at least one accepted qualified solver lineage exactly. Unknown/newer solver postimages fail closed until F-PM re-reads their qualification evidence and adds an explicit accepted lineage.

admission_rules: Candidate ref resolves to one exact commit and descends from F-CI18.
Composed downstream candidate is itself TESTED and QUALIFIED.
Composed downstream candidate explicitly admits physical SWAP runtime/source use; deterministic-test-backend qualification alone is insufficient.
Candidate contains the exact F-KT05 minimum transaction boundary; qualified successors may coexist.
Candidate matches at least one explicitly accepted, source-bound qualified F-SI lineage.
No F-PM production process source changes are allowed on any failed or unknown check.

allowed: Move the characterized B1.10 snow process body behind a kernel-facing process interface without changing equations.
Keep physical continuation state limited to ssnow and slw.
Keep snowinco outside physical continuation state.
Add source-bound O0/O2 regression, transaction and mass-identity tests.
not_allowed: Infer subdaily or generic-duration snow scaling from daily legacy coefficients.
Change precipitation partitioning, snowcoef semantics, melt/sublimation equations or mass tolerance.
Move I/O or calendar-day orchestration into the kernel process.
